en: Museum postcard from Romania reproducing an old engraving: a view of Bucharest with a hilltop princely palace complex and church towers above the Dâmbovița River, a wooden bridge with carts and people, watermills on the bank, and figures in period dress in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian address fields and credits the Art Museum of the Socialist Republic of Romania; the image is titled "Palace at Bucharest," engraved by William Watts after Luigi Mayer.
